case.summary: Case HHG-009 was opened on 2016-12-28 when customer C08299 reported a fraudulent online transaction 3581141 for $30.02 on card C08299-K1. Graph analysis and the closed-case classifier scored the transaction at 1.00 fraud probability under the card_not_present_fraud pattern. Since the customer denied the transaction, policy R2 recommended blocking the card and creating a case. The final recommended actions are BLOCK_CARD routed to L1 and CREATE_CASE routed automatically.
